role: development-only reuse of inspected depth FD records; neither training nor evaluation is independent confirmation
training_design: 29 original FD sources plus four already-inspected +/-160 m depth FD sources; scratch 5000 receiver-only steps at 128 samples per event, then 1000 physics/receiver steps at 64 samples per event; same 5 Hz eikonal carrier and seed 42, no onset gate; only the receiver training set changes
evaluation_design: eight already-inspected +/-80 and +/-280 m depth FD sources, no retraining or tuned shift/gain; paired true-source raw and FD-active L2, finite depth-response L2 and cosine, false early threshold picks; report +/-280 m subset separately
decision_rule: proceed only if mean FD-active L2 and finite depth-response L2 improve over the 29-source model, +/-280 m active L2 improves, and no anchor neighborhood degrades sharply; early picks alone do not count
